title: Genie Code is now available on HIPAA compliance security profile workspaces with partner-powered AI features disabled
body:
Genie Code is now available on workspaces that have the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled with the **HIPAA** compliance standard selected and partner-powered AI features disabled. On these workspaces, Genie Code is served by Databricks-hosted models rather than partner-powered models.

For the full list of AI assistive features affected by the partner-powered AI features setting and the hosting provider used by each, see [Partner-powered AI features](/aws/en/databricks-ai/partner-powered).
